verdict.rationale: Elicit lets researchers bring in their own corpus via Zotero import, RIS/BIB uploads, and Collections, then run extraction (columns), chat, and systematic-review analysis over that library (elicit-docs-37, elicit-docs-38, elicit-docs-18, elicit-docs-40, elicit-docs-49). However, evidence centers on importing citation/metadata files or Zotero collections rather than a direct raw-PDF drag-and-drop upload, and community reports flag notable hallucination/accuracy issues when reasoning over papers, which tempers reliability. Missing for 10: explicit direct PDF file upload workflow (vs. RIS/BIB/Zotero import), and independent verification that agent research over an uploaded corpus is accurate.
